feeds.title: Journal of the American Revolution
feeds.description: Journal of the American Revolution is the leading source of knowledge about the American Revolution and Founding. Featuring smart, groundbreaking research and well-written narratives from expert writers. Journal of the American Revolution also produces annual hardcover volumes, a branded book series, and the podcast, Dispatches.

feeds.title: Age of Revolutions » American Revolution
feeds.description: Age of Revolutions is an open-access, peer-reviewed journal that publishes scholarly articles delving into intricate passages of world and medieval history, particularly social and political revolutions. Read the latest post dissecting Napoleonic France and contemporary literary culture.

feeds.title: National Society Sons of the American Revolution News
feeds.description: Follow regular updates, press releases, and official statements from NSSAR. The Sons of the American Revolution Society honors Revolutionary War patriot ancestors by promoting patriotism, serving our communities, and educating and inspiring future generations about the founding principles of America.

feeds.title: Together We Served Blog » Revolutionary War
feeds.description: Plunge into a trove of some of the greatest Revolutionary War stories in these archives, Explore various stands, battles, facts, and trivia in this blog. TogetherWeServed.com is the largest U.S. Military Veteran website where Veterans reconnect with those they fought along during their service.

feeds.title: Historical Novel Society » American Revolution
feeds.description: Read reviews of the best historical fiction set in the American Revolution using America's War of Independence as their backdrop. The Historical Novel Society is an international open-membership society showcasing a large collection of the best and most complete guides to the genre of Historical Fiction.

feeds.title: Revolutionary War Journal
feeds.description: Revolutionary War Journal produces well-researched and well-documented articles exploring a variety of facets of the American War of Independence. From American Revolution battles to daily life issues, here you will find a plethora of resources to relive and understand the revolution.

feeds.title: Reason » American Revolution
feeds.description: Visit Reason Magazine's archive of articles filed under American Revolution. Discover writings and viewpoints exploring a spectrum of historical facts and analyses. Reason Magazine is the leading libertarian magazine and covers news, politics, culture, and more with reporting and analysis.

feeds.title: Researching the American Revolution
feeds.description: Gene Procknow's blog is devoted to researchers and students looking for information on the American Revolution. Updates and blog posts highlight new Revolutionary Ear books, research, and discoveries of major events and people.

feeds.title: Portsmouthhistorynotes » Revolutionary War
feeds.description: Gloria Schmidt's research notebook of topics in Portsmouth, RI history. Delve into lesser-known or unconventional topics related to the Revolutionary War. Read personally narrated stories, anecdotes, and other exciting and compelling summaries.

feeds.title: American Revolution Round Table of Richmond
feeds.description: The American Revolution Round Table of Richmond is devoted to the study of all aspects of the Revolutionary period. Composed of a group of eclectic, yet historically-minded individuals, the ARRT-R provides a forum for the exploration, discussion, and sharing of knowledge about this interesting and critical period of American history.

feeds.title: Emerging Revolutionary War Era
feeds.description: Emerging Revolutionary War serves as a public history-oriented platform dedicated to sharing original scholarship and discussion on the American Revolution. Follow to stay tuned with the latest updates.

feeds.title: Historic Ipswich » Revolutionary War
feeds.description: Read articles and fascinating stories of people from the times of the American Revolution. Historic Ipswich is produced by historian Gordon Harris for the Ipswich Visitor Center, with the aim to promote, spread, and enlighten readers about its history and involvement during the revolutionary war.

feeds.title: Crossroads of the American Revolution Blog
feeds.description: Crossroads of the American Revolution National Heritage Area in New Jersey offers an unprecedented opportunity to explore the impact of the American Revolution. Keep up with latest updates, programs, online webinar announcements through the blog.

feeds.title: The Strawfoot » American Revolutionary War
feeds.description: Keith Muchowski is an academic librarian and associate professor at New York City College of Technology. In his blog The Strawfoot, Keith rummages and discusses a variety of aspects and shares his own thoughts, reflections, and connections to the American Revolution, providing a unique and subjective viewpoint.

feeds.title: The Online Review of Rhode Island History » American Revolution
feeds.description: Read all articles tagged American Revolution. The Online Review of Rhode Island History intends to offer a variety of articles intended for a popular audience, hoping to make the state's history interesting and fun, and eventually create an impressive archive of articles for both readers and researchers.

feeds.title: Salina B Baker
feeds.description: Salina is a multiple award-winning historical fiction author and American Revolution and Victorian America historian. Uncover exciting facets of the Revolutionary period through in-depth, captivating biographies, stories and other articles.

feeds.title: Samantha Wilcoxson
feeds.description: Join author and historian Samantha Wilcoxson on her odyssey through the American epoch and contemporary era. Gain a behind-the-scenes look at her latest projects, book excerpts, ideas, and personal reflections on key historical events.

feeds.title: The Conversation » American Revolution
feeds.description: Browse American Revolution news, research, and analysis from The Conversation. The Conversation is a unique collaboration between academics and journalists that in a decade has become the world's leading publisher of research-based news and analysis.

feeds.title: Boston 1777
feeds.description: Boston 1775 is all about history, analysis, and unabashed gossip about the start of the American Revolution in Massachusetts. Blog author J. L. BELL is a Massachusetts writer who specializes in (among other things) the start of the American Revolution in and around Boston. Find interesting historic facts and perspectives about the revolution.

feeds.title: American Heritage Education Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The American Heritage Education Foundation, Inc., is a non-profit organization dedicated to the understanding and teaching of Americas factual and philosophical heritage to promote freedom, unity, progress, and responsibility among students and citizens. Provides free K-12 curriculum for all educators in social studies, U. S. history, U. S. government, philosophy, political science, or economics.

feeds.title: British Soldiers, American Revolution
feeds.description: Information about British soldiers who served during the American Revolution, 1775-1783. Thousands of soldiers wore red coats, but little is known about them as individuals. This site changes that, soldier by soldier. I give lectures about the American RevolutionLearn more about British Soldiers in the Revolutionary War!

feeds.title: The American Patriot Series
feeds.description: The American Patriot Series is a comprehensive fictional series of stories on the American Revolution. Joan M. Shoup, writing as J. M. Hochstetler, writes stories that always involve some element of the past and of finding a home. Discover her upcoming books, ideas and personal updates here.
